goal_details.name: summarize
goal_details.response: Under the Finnish travel regulation (Valtion matkustussääntö), a domestic trip must last at least 6 hours for a partial per diem (osapäiväraha) and over 10 hours for a full per diem (kokopäiväraha).

story: The user asks about domestic per diem duration thresholds under Finnish government travel rules.
starting_sentence: How many hours does a domestic trip need to last before per diem is paid?
